delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: It invokes a verification sub-agent for external fact-checking or advanced debugging, returning a definitive, verified result.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: real-time supervision, SUPERVISORAGENT mitigates common failure modes and reduces computational overhead

self_verification.evidence_quote: run_verification: The deepest intervention, used in complex error contexts when internal information is insufficient. It invokes a verification sub-agent for external fact-checking

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Now let's retry: take care not to repeat previous errors! If you have retried several times, try a completely different approach.
retry_policy.note: Step-level error retry prompt only; no task-level retry policy. pass@k reported as repeated independent runs in evaluation.

rollback.evidence_quote: This action replaces the original raw observation entirely with a cleaned and corrected version.

termination_condition.note: step_number field implies a step budget; final answer ends the run.

filesystem_access.note: Closest value: filesystem modules are blocked by default in the local interpreter, but host FS is otherwise unisolated.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism; web search tools call external APIs (SerpApi).
